title: cota × ochroleuca
intro: Cota × ochroleuca, commonly known as the Mountain Cornflower or Ochroleucous, is a hybrid plant species within the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Cota × ochroleuca include exhibiting antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine for treating various ailments. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
